assets.title: Brass Arc Navigation Sextant
assets.description: Original static low-poly navigation sextant with an open fan-shaped brass framework, separate dark graduation arc and 61 physical scale marks, a fixed pivot-connected index arm and arc shoe, two distinct supported silver mirror plates in U-shaped seats, a short supported sighting tube and a rear wooden grip. Four radial ribs and an inner arch form six real cut-through framework windows. Two integral compact display feet support the arc. All named components connect through actual finite interior overlaps to grounded feet; handle/frame and tube/frame clearance are checked. Six flat solid PBR materials, no textures or external resources. Metres, native Z up, front -Y and ground origin at centre. One original reusable instrument, distinct from the earlier compass, map table and telescope. Static stylized visual only: no optical-path validity, angular measurement, calibration, navigation, moving mechanism, stability or safety certification.
